non_blocking_findings.finding: True-device smoke for P2-005 now covers one physical phone: HMA-AL00 / Android 10 / API 29. The no-model state, profile activation path, mock generation reply, and pid-scoped logcat check passed on that device.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Treat this as sufficient for P2-005 task closure, but do not treat it as replacement readiness. Keep broader device matrix and Phase 2/P6 validation open.

non_blocking_findings.finding: OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic-compatible runtime classes currently build protocol payloads and return disabled-live-call failures; they do not perform network I/O.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Treat this as the intended P2 foundation. Add live HTTP client selection, secret retrieval, retries, and provider-specific diagnostics only in a later explicitly approved provider validation task.

non_blocking_findings.finding: Stale-token protection is covered inside ChatGenerationRepository, but process-death/background job ownership is not implemented.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep LEG-016 as a P0 blocker until P3-001 adds WorkManager/job isolation and deleted-session safeguards.

non_blocking_findings.finding: The preview app uses FakeLlmGenerationRuntime so successful generation appears as a local mock reply.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep UI copy, coverage registry, and release notes clear that this is preview/mock generation, not live provider readiness.

non_blocking_findings.finding: P2-005 local acceptance coverage now includes fake failure/timeout outcomes, provider failure mapping, streamed persistence, after-runtime stale-token rejection, unsupported vision downgrade, blank prompt blocking, and provider payload context.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep these as regression fixtures for P2-006 and P3-001; add device evidence separately once ADB sees a phone.
